BiblicalUsage: Hashem is a name that appears once, as the father of two of David's mighty men. In 1 Chronicles 11:34 the sons of Hashem the Gizonite stand in the list, and the verse gives us nothing else about the father himself.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse is a reminder that the mighty men had fathers, and the fathers had names, and God kept them all.
